verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile's own page says users can ask Copilot, in natural language, to guide them through codebases, give insights into public and private repositories, and open a new pull request. That matches the story nearly word for word, and Copilot's documented ability to answer repository questions and review pull requests backs it up. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the mobile chat experience (beyond marketing copy), and independent or hands-on corroboration of Copilot chat working on mobile.
